snippet.title: Roar Rampage Classic - Pre-order on Mobile
snippet.description:
Pre-register on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neutronized.roarrampage
Pre-order on iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/roar-rampage-classic/id6742753816

Get ready to smash, punch, and demolish everything in your path! Take control of a furious, city-wrecking kaiju on a rampage, armed with nothing but raw strength and an oversized boxing glove. Destroy buildings, battle powerful enemies, and unleash chaos in this action-packed arcade brawler!



Features:
• Physics based destruction engine
• Multiple kaiju skins to unlock
• Easy one finger controls
• Explosive arcade action gameplay
• Amazing soundtrack
